title: hyozuboard Card
description: A card is a self-contained data packet pinned to the home screen. All values for all selectable dimension combinations are pre-loaded — toggling is instant, local, zero-fetch. Selectors and context are always visible regardless of card size. The show array controls progressive disclosure of body elements only.

label.description: Displayed uppercase in the card header row.

meta.description: Contextual metadata for AI reasoning, search, and interpretation. Not rendered visually — consumed by agents and the platform.

description.description: Plain-language explanation of what this card measures, why it matters, and how to interpret it.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Omit for non-monetary values.

unit.description: What kind of value this is.

magnitude.description: What the display value is expressed in. Lets AI do math correctly.

thresholds.description: Named reference points for AI interpretation. Not rendered.

value.description: Same unit and magnitude as the card value.

selectors.description: Toggleable axes. Rendered as dropdown selects inline in the card header row. Always visible. Toggling filters the pre-loaded data array locally — no fetch required.

context.description: Fixed dimensional labels. Always visible. Rendered as subtle pills in the card footer zone. Not interactive.

display_name.description: Cached display name. Fallback when host can't resolve user_id.

data_source.description: Rendered as a small circular icon with tooltip in the footer, not as text.

system.description: System of record shown on tooltip hover.

agent.description: Agent or workflow that produced the data.

updated.description: ISO 8601. Humanized by the host renderer.

variants.description: Must include at least one variant. Each defines grid size and which body elements are visible. Selectors and context are always visible regardless of what show contains.

workspace_ref.description: Drill-through reference. Tap card to open the source workspace.

resolve.description: Optional live resolver. When present, a status indicator appears in the card header. Pre-loaded data in body serves as fallback when the resolver is unavailable or the user lacks permissions.

extension.description: The hyozuboard extension that handles the fetch.

interval.description: Auto-refresh interval in seconds. Omit for on-demand only.

grid.description: [columns, rows] on the 12-column grid. small=[3,1], large=[4,1], wide=[6,1], tall=[3,2], full=[6,2].

show.description: Which body elements are visible at this size. Metric cards use: value, delta, chart. Table cards use: rows, headers. Selectors and context are always visible and do not appear here.

max_rows.description: For table cards: maximum number of rows to display at this size.

semantic_color.description: Resolved by the active theme at render time. primary = dominant data. secondary = comparison/reference. success/danger = directional outcome. muted = background-level.

data.description: Pre-loaded records. For cards with selectors, each record includes selector key-value pairs. The renderer filters by current selection. For cards without selectors, all records are always active.

metric_record.description: One metric value for one selector combination. Properties matching selector keys are filter values. series is an array — a single record can carry multiple overlaid series.

value.description: Formatted by source workspace. The card renderer displays this as-is.

direction.description: Semantic direction. Renderer maps to theme colors: positive=success, negative=danger, neutral=muted.

period.description: What the delta is measured against.

series.description: Chart series for this record. Multiple entries overlay on the same chart. For multi-series, each should have a label for the legend.

label.description: Legend label. Required when multiple series are present.

additionalProperties.description: Selector key-value pairs. Keys must match keys in the card's selectors object.

label.description: Column header text. Visible when headers is in the show array.

type.description: Determines rendering. tag=pill badge. timestamp=ISO 8601, humanized by host. url=hidden from display, available for on_row_action.

data.description: Row objects keyed by column keys. Timestamp values must be ISO 8601. URL values are full hrefs. Empty string means no action for that row.

on_row_action.description: Handler for row tap/click. Defines what happens when a user interacts with a row.

url_column.description: For open_url: which column key contains the href.
